entries.title: Psalms 115:1
segments: ¶Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name let glory be given, because of your mercy and your unchanging faith.

entries.title: Psalms 115:2
segments: Why may the nations say, Where is now their God?

entries.title: Psalms 115:3
segments: But our God is in heaven: he has done whatever was pleasing to him.

entries.title: Psalms 115:4
segments: Their images are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 115:5
segments: They have mouths, but no voice; they have eyes, but they see not;

entries.title: Psalms 115:6
segments: They have ears, but no hearing; they have noses, but no sense of smell;

entries.title: Psalms 115:7
segments: They have hands without feeling, and feet without power of walking; and no sound comes from their throat.

entries.title: Psalms 115:8
segments: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his faith in them.

entries.title: Psalms 115:9
segments: ¶O Israel, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

entries.title: Psalms 115:10
segments: O house of Aaron, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

entries.title: Psalms 115:11
segments: You worshippers of the Lord, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.

entries.title: Psalms 115:12
segments: The Lord has kept us in mind and will give us his blessing; he will send blessings on the house of Israel and on the house of Aaron.

entries.title: Psalms 115:13
segments: He will send blessings on the worshippers of the Lord, on the small and on the great.

entries.title: Psalms 115:14
segments: May the Lord give you and your children still greater increase.

entries.title: Psalms 115:15
segments: May you have the blessing of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

entries.title: Psalms 115:16
segments: The heavens are the Lord's; but the earth he has given to the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 115:17
segments: The dead do not give praise to the Lord; or those who go down to the underworld.

entries.title: Psalms 115:18
segments: But we will give praise to the Lord now and for ever. Praise be to the Lord.
